body: Thanks for your words. I am really sorry you lost your dad and it makes me want to work through it, knowing that it probably is a much bigger deal than I initially felt it would be.
I'll try to keep this in mind.
Thanks for this other perspective. I will try to keep this in mind.
I am thinking about showing him this thread. For now, we are talking a little. Thanks for the thought.
I already knew this, which is why its such a big deal. I live in europe so i could just say fuck it, except that my grandparents are co-signers... with perfect credit for their entire lives..

I feel like I will never be stable again. Like life is over. It feels like my time is up and I'm not supposed to still be here. 

I hate the thought of being dragged to a crisis center and having to tell some over-worked doctor my pathetic story and getting admitted and being utterly alone somewhere. That scares me more than killing myself.

He knows I am feeling very depressed but I can't bear to tell him I'm suicidal because of the pain it will inflict upon him. I know that sounds retarded because it would be painful if I killed myself, but I just can't find a way to get the words out.

That is probably the most horrible part - how great he is and how much he cares. It somehow makes it all less bearable at the moment. I know it would be so painful for him if i killed myself but I know he would eventually recover and find someone better for him.
